values.noticeBody: Mobile service technicians dispatch from Sarasota, Monday–Friday, 8 AM – 5 PM. After hours service runs 8:00 PM – 5:00 AM via Certified Fleet.

items.title: Truck sales
items.body: New and used International trucks, IC Bus and Capacity yard trucks, with financing arranged in house.

items.title: Parts counter
items.body: Genuine OEM and all-makes truck and trailer parts, Saturday morning hours, plus online ordering and delivery.

items.title: Service & trailer bays
items.body: Factory-trained technicians, dedicated trailer repair bays, DOT inspections and alignment, open until 5 PM on weekdays.

items.title: In-store shopping
items.body: In-store shopping and curbside pickup, with after-hours service coverage through Certified Fleet.

items.title: Trailer parts & service in Sarasota
items.body: When your trailer requires maintenance, you can depend on Sun State for all your trailer parts and service needs. Sarasota runs dedicated trailer repair bays covering kingpins, landing gear, aluminum and fiberglass repair, brakes, liftgates and DOT inspections, with Hyundai and all-makes trailer parts on the shelf.

items.title: We'll come to your yard
items.body: Mobile service runs out of Sarasota Monday through Friday, 8 AM – 5 PM, performing many repairs, diagnostics and preventative maintenance at your location across Sarasota, Manatee and Charlotte counties.

values.heading: Other Sun State locations.
values.body: Ready to find the right commercial trucks for your business? Visit us at our convenient locations across Central and Southwest Florida.

items.q: Where is Sun State International in Sarasota?
items.a: Sun State International Trucks is at 1000 Sarasota Center Blvd., Sarasota, FL 34240, off Sarasota Center Blvd near I-75. Phone (941) 355-7681, fax (941) 351-9108.

Sales are open 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM Monday through Friday. Parts are open 7:00 AM to 5:00 PM Monday through Friday and 8:00 AM to 12:00 PM Saturday. Service is open 7:00 AM to 5:00 PM Monday through Friday. Closed Sunday.

items.q: Is after-hours service available in Sarasota?
items.a: Yes. After hours service runs 8:00 PM to 5:00 AM via Certified Fleet at (863) 880-2206.

items.q: Which number do I call for service in Sarasota?
items.a: Call the Sarasota Service Department at (941) 541-3251, or the main dealership line at (941) 355-7681. Service appointments can also be requested online.

items.q: Do you repair trailers in Sarasota?
items.a: Yes. Sarasota has dedicated trailer repair bays and stocks Hyundai and all-makes trailer parts, covering kingpins, landing gear, brakes, liftgates and DOT inspections.

items.q: Which areas does the Sarasota location serve?
items.a: Sarasota serves Sarasota, Manatee and Charlotte counties, including Bradenton, Venice, Palmetto, North Port and Punta Gorda, with mobile service available at your yard or job site.

values.heading: Ready to get on the road?
values.body: Contact us to explore our trucks and experience nothing less than the dedicated care you deserve.
